completion100.note: Built from the official descriptions: these are the categories the game counts toward A Long Road. Counts are the PSN targets where the official list publishes them; anything else is our reading, labelled as such.
completion100.title: 100% Completion — the ten counted categories

note: Every trophy sits in exactly one stage. Play the stages in order; stages 3–6 can overlap with the story, stage 7 is cleanup after the credits.

stages.name: Story first
stages.tip: Play the story straight through. Meditate and snap WAiNK spots when you pass them, but do not chase collectibles yet — the map stays open after the credits.

stages.name: Strangers & side strands
stages.tagline: Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret — and 8 stranger strands
stages.tip: Stranger icons appear as you explore. Each strand is a short chain with its own final mission; finish a strand when it opens so none is left dangling.

stages.name: Activities sampler
stages.tagline: One taste of everything, then gold the range
stages.tip: Try all 9 activity types for Master of None, then settle into the 42 Shooting Range golds — the longest skill check in the list. Meditate at every spot you find: this is a missable-watch item.

stages.name: Collectibles & exploration
stages.tip: Sweep the map region by region: 52 areas, 100 WAiNK spots, 100 vehicles, 3 card sets, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations. One region at a time beats criss-crossing the state.

stages.name: Crime & combat
stages.tip: Plan getaways before alarms. Five bank vaults, one operation per gang, and the wanted-level trophies all reward patience over firepower.

stages.name: Grinds & money
stages.tip: These counts build across all play — check them late and grind only the remainder. Play dialogue choices deliberately: Actions Speak Louder is a missable-watch item.

stages.name: Cleanup, secrets & 100%
stages.tagline: Cryptic trophies, A Long Road, then the platinum
stages.tip: Mop up the cryptic trophies, finish the 100% Completion list, and the platinum pops with A Long Road. Check the Missables view once more before you call it done.

title: Road to the Platinum — 7 stages, 55 trophies
